QuestInfo.name: Alex's Request
QuestInfo.0: There is a runaway kid named #p402# in #m10003000#...
QuestInfo.1: On a lonely building rooftop in #m10003000#, I met a boy named #p402#, who's run away from home because of a fight with his father, #p202#, in #m10001000#. But #p402# is exhausted from being on the run and is out of money. He wants to go home and try to work things out with his strict, but admittedly loving, father. He asked me if I could persuade his father to not punish him for what he did. Also, he wants me to bring the #b#t4031006##k his mother left him when she died, as proof that he really did have his father's forgiveness.
QuestInfo.2: As #p402# requested, I looked for his father in #m10001000# to get #p402#'s mother's #b#t4031006##k.

0.0: Hey, hear me out. A couple of days ago I ran away from home to get away from my very straight laced father. So, here I am, in #m10003000#, just wandering around. I've spent all the money I secretly took from my dad's safe, and I'm sick of this, to be honest. I shouldn't have run away.
0.1: I don't think my dad will just let me walk back in the door... Not without beating the bejeebus out of me. Can you find a way to calm him down? I need your help, man.

yes.0: Thank you! My father is #p202# in #m10001000#. Because he's a man of power, he's strict. He and I just can't get through to each other. My father has a LOUD personality, so you can't be too submissive when you talk to him. I'm sure you'll figure something out.
yes.1: To prove you've calmed my father down, ask him for his #t4031006#. It was my mother's before she passed away. He always said he'd never give it to a guy like me, so if he does... It'll mean he's forgiven me. I'll be waiting!

no.0: You won't do me a favor because I'm an immature kid who ran away from home, right? I understand, but I'm trying to... Ah, never mind.

1.0: Who are you? I don't think we've met.

npc.0: My father is the chief of #m10001000#. Please convince him to let me come back home. As proof that he's forgiven me, please also convince him to give me his #t4031006#, which belonged to my mother.
